hints: Notice block L has $0.46$ $\text{kg m s}^{-1}$ to the left before collision and $0.12$ $\text{kg m s}^{-1}$ to the right after, so its velocity reverses.
Take one direction as positive and write initial and final momentum of L with signs, then find $\Delta p = p_{final} - p_{initial}$.
Use impulse $F\Delta t = \Delta p$ with $\Delta t = 0.084$ $\text{s}$ and take the magnitude for the average force on L.
walkthrough: Choose positive to the right. Then L moves left initially, so $p_{initial} = -0.46$ $\text{kg m s}^{-1}$.
After collision L moves back to the right, so $p_{final} = +0.12$ $\text{kg m s}^{-1}$.
Change of momentum is $\Delta p = p_{final} - p_{initial} = 0.12 - (-0.46) = 0.58$ $\text{kg m s}^{-1}$.
Average force follows from $F = \Delta p / \Delta t$, with contact time $\Delta t = 0.084$ $\text{s}$.
Substitute: $F = 0.58 / 0.084 \approx 6.90$ $\text{N}$, so magnitude is about $6.9$ $\text{N}$. This is option C.
